source: the label solver of the animageo_web client (the version that r4.py ports)
units: CSS px of the sheet, y down; box = [l, t, r, b]
note: Each step is one layout call: list (or {ref: step} = the list of an earlier step), view, paint, memory (before the call; null = none) and what the client solver returned: every label after the call (x, y, box), the memory (k of each placed label) and the stats.
ties: Expectations follow the tie rule of r4.py (gaps equal within 1e-9 rad, a direction at a half octant within 1e-9 octant goes up, costs within the relative 1e-12), not the last bit of the recording. Changed by it: synthetic/seed-5 steps 0-4 (P11: k 6 -> 3, the memory chain with it) and step 3 (t1: k 3 -> 2, the place P11 took).
